svg.text: ① 切片 chunk_start = seq.prefill_offset

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: chunk_end = min(chunk_start + prefill_chunk_size, prompt_len)

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ② is_first_chunk ?

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ⑵a 是 → 首个 chunk

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 按【整段 prompt】一次性分配块：

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: blocks = ceil(prompt_len / kv_block_size)

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: past_kv = None（还没有历史 KV）

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ⑵b 否 → 后续 chunk

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: past_kv = build_past_key_values()

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 从 paged pool 读回 [0, offset) 的 KV，

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 再 permute 成 HF 的 [B, kv_heads, T, d]

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 是

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 否

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ③ forward(input_ids=chunk_ids, past_key_values=past_kv)

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 新 token 的 position 由 past_kv 的长度隐式决定 —— 这就是"顺序"的来源

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ④ new_past_kv 覆盖 [0, chunk_end) —— 注意它【包含】prior cache

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 所以取本 chunk 新算的那段要用负索引：source_position = i − chunk_len

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ⑤ 写回 pool global_pos = chunk_start + i

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: → block_idx = global_pos // kv_block_size slot = global_pos % kv_block_size

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ⑥ seq.prefill_offset = chunk_end （游标单调前进：不重叠、不遗漏）

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: ⑦ is_last_chunk ? → 是：采样 logits[:, -1, :] → 首个 token，state = decoding

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 为什么同时有 block 和 chunk 两个单位？

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: block（kv_block_size=16）= 存储单位 → 写 pool 时用

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: chunk（prefill_chunk_size=128）= 计算单位 → forward 时用

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 两者互不相干：8 个 chunk 均匀落到若干 block 上

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: prefill 结束时 live cache 是【空的】

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: chunked prefill 从不把 new_past_kv 挂到 seq 上，

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: pool 是唯一真源；所以 decode 的第一步会

text.font-family: Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

svg.text: 再从 pool 重建一次（见 0014 §5）
